思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S10 「养老院机构：ready for qa 的 build 上不存在机构（AC 3 的机构部分）」 Nursing Home facility: no facility exists on the ready-for-qa build (AC 3 facility part)

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S10

Nursing Home facility: no facility exists on the ready-for-qa build (AC 3 facility part)

Tickets: TFA-92581 Search & Sort (ready for qa)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status known-gap → 已知缺口（已知缺口）。

Detail:

No. At e02167f a Nursing Home resident has no facility field anywhere in the chain. The snf resident record (snfFields in convex/lib/validators.ts, which convex/schema.ts spreads into snfResidents) holds name, age, dob, sex, mrn, unit and so on, but no facility. snf:add takes exactly those fields as its args, so the mutation can't accept a facility either. The Add Resident form asks only for Full Name, Date of Birth, Unit / Room and MRN, plus Encounter Type. SnfPatientCard builds its identity line from unit, dob, age and mrn. matchesPatientSearch matches on name, room, unit, mrn and diagnosis. A case-insensitive search for 'facility' under apps/web finds only prompt text, billing labels and comments, never a data field. This is exactly the recorded gap known:no-facility. As the oracle says, U4's facility part and U6's facility field are a Fail on TFA-92581, not Blocked or not-built, and that holds whatever Q1 decides about where facility comes from. No open question is waiting on this, and the question's pass/fail rule agrees with the Then/Oracle.

确认的已知缺口（knownGapsConfirmed）：

  • apps/web/convex/lib/validators.ts:331: The snf resident record (snfFields) has name, mrn and unit but no facility field.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/validators.ts:336: The identity fields in the record are mrn and unit only; no facility follows them.
  • apps/web/convex/snf.ts:179: snf:add takes residentFields (= snfFields) as its args, so the mutation cannot accept a facility.
  • apps/web/src/components/clinical/PatientCard.tsx:292: SnfPatientCard's identity line is built from unit, dob, age and mrn only, so no facility is shown on the card.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/patientList.ts:127: matchesPatientSearch accepts only name, room, unit, mrn and diagnosis, so Nursing Home search cannot match a facility.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/patientList.ts:141: The values the search matcher compares are name, room, unit, mrn and diagnosis; facility is not among them.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/validators.ts:331: The snf resident record/validator (snfFields, spread into the schema and used as snf:add args) has no facility field; the identity fields are name, dob, sex, mrn and unit only.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/validators.ts:336: The identity fields in snfFields stop at mrn and unit; there is no facility key.
  • apps/web/convex/snf.ts:179: snf:add takes residentFields (snfFields) as its args, so it cannot accept a facility value.
  • apps/web/src/routes/snf/AddResident.tsx:41: The Add Resident form's default values hold no facility field.
  • apps/web/src/routes/snf/AddResident.tsx:84: The add() payload sends unit and mrn but no facility.
  • apps/web/src/components/clinical/PatientCard.tsx:292: SnfPatientCard's identity line is built from unit, DOB, age and MRN only; no facility is shown.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/patientList.ts:127: matchesPatientSearch matches name, room, unit, mrn and diagnosis only, so search cannot match a facility.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q1 (where facility comes from) is still open, but the oracle says this Fail holds whatever Q1 decides.
  • Q1 (where facility should come from) is still open. The oracle says the Fail holds whatever Q1 decides, so it does not change this verdict.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • A person still has to sign off this doc review, as the oracle requires.
  • Confirming on the running app with S11's form snapshot and S09's card snapshots belongs to other scenarios.
  • A person still has to sign off on this doc review, as the oracle requires.
  • Confirming this on the running app (S11 form snapshot, S09 card snapshots) belongs to other lanes.

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：A physician adding a Nursing Home resident has no place to enter the facility, never sees a facility on the resident card, and cannot find residents by searching for a facility name. / A physician cannot record which nursing home a resident is in. They cannot see it on the resident card and cannot find residents by searching for a facility name, so residents from different facilities appear together in one list.

审查结论（verdict）：fail
